blackjack: Preset selects the increment and starting total; + adds that increment, - subtracts it. 100K + + = 300K. Total accepts multiples of 10; server wallet check and signed-integer payout bound apply. Prepared chip max remains 100K.
slot: Classic Sardis three-reel Slot only. Five exact stakes 10/100/1K/10K/100K; original server engine weights and multipliers unchanged. Shared real wallet; UUID receipts atomically protect spin/purchase retries.
bonus: Server-priced purchase: 10 spins for 10x stake; confirmed total cost and balance; locked stake; stored remaining spins; no autoplay.
ranking: Slot joins Wheel, Crash and Blackjack; Istanbul hour/day/week/month, top 50 actual paid payouts, server totals.
art: Existing light/dark Lidya PNG seven/cherry/lemon/bell/diamond/crown/coin reused, no code-generated artwork.

validation.browser: 28 scenarios: 6 Blackjack + 8 Slot + 7 Crash + 7 Wheel; 320/390/540px light/dark, additive stake, restore, bonus, lost response UUID retry, close during animation

deployment: Frontend and backend together. Existing startup Base.metadata.create_all creates classic_slot_accounts and classic_slot_receipts. Legacy /games/slot/play returns 410. No live PostgreSQL load test or production deploy performed.
